question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is 'Neccessary.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let us explore the options:- • '**Accumulate**' means To** ****collect a number or quantity of something over a period of time**. • '​**Occasion**' means **A particular time when something happens**. • '**Remittance**' means **A sum of money sent in payment or as a gift**. • '​​​​​**Neccessary**': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word. • The correct spelling is '​Necessary' means **Needed to be done, achieved, or present; essential**. Hence, the correct answer is option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • The synonyms of the word '​Necessary' are "**Obligatory, Requisite, Required**". • Example of '__​__Necessary' i__n a__ sentence__: • *Light and water are **necessary** for plants*. cf:Teb2,
